svg.title: Three Built-in Challenges and Their Fixes
svg.desc: Three challenges and their mitigations: fabrication is countered by grounding and human review, unreliability by low temperature and evaluation, and bias by representative data and evaluation across groups.
svg.text: Three Built-in Challenges and Their Fixes
Each comes from how the model works, so each needs a structural mitigation.
Plus human review where stakes are high
